patient_context.history: Type 2 diabetes; currently taking metformin ER.

interaction.prompt: Use the supplied evidence to determine the medication-safety implication of the current eGFR. Give the evidence-supported next high-level action and avoid unsupported treatment substitution.

must_include: Apply the contraindication/discontinuation rule to current metformin ER use.
Keep the response at medication-review level rather than prescribing an alternative.
must_not_claim: Do not round 29 up and treat it as above the threshold.
Do not invent a specific replacement medication or dose.
acceptable_actions: Flag the label conflict and recommend prompt clinician medication review.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Threshold conclusion is supported; broader treatment selection remains outside the evidence.

critical_errors: Treats eGFR 29 as outside the contraindication threshold.
Recommends continued or increased metformin without acknowledging the label conflict.
